verses.1: Do not envy those who are evil, and do not want to be like them.
verses.2: For the devil will enter their hearts, and their lips will speak evil.
verses.3: In wisdom, he will build a house; in planning, he will arrange everything carefully.
verses.4: And in the darkness, all the holes are filled with precious and fragrant substances.
verses.5: A wise man with great wisdom and a person of great knowledge.
verses.6: For in your battles, you will fight and be victorious with great strength.
verses.7: Wisdom is like a lion’s den; its doors will never be opened.
verses.8: It’s better for the enemy to think that he has the upper hand.
verses.9: It is the punishment for sin and hatred towards man.
verses.10: You were weakened on a day of great difficulty and hardship.
verses.11: They take them to death and use them for killing. If you try to resist, they will kill you.
verses.12: For if they say, “We do not know this,” then he will understand and be able to restore your soul to its rightful place. He will know what to do.
verses.13: “My son, eat grass, for it is good. And sleep in peace, for you will be safe.”
verses.14: So, know wisely for your soul: if you find one, and there is another one as well, then your desire shall not be fulfilled.
verses.15: Do not let the wicked appear to be righteous, and do not let the wicked deceive others.
verses.16: For seven righteous people will rise up, while the wicked will be defeated.
verses.17: In your failure, do not rejoice; and in your downfall, do not be sad.
verses.18: If Jehovah does not see it, and it is evil in His eyes, then He will take it back from them.
verses.19: Do not be partial to the wicked; do not pity the evil ones.
verses.20: For one who does not follow in the footsteps of the wicked, the wicked will surely know about him.
verses.21: May you fear Jehovah, my son, and be king with those who are different from you. Do not be offended.
verses.22: For suddenly, someone will rise up, and both of them will be unknown to each other.
verses.23: Also, these wise men are those who judge others fairly in their judgments.
verses.24: He said, “For the wicked, you will find them. Nations will be angry with them, and they will be hated by God.”
verses.25: And those who are angry will be calmed, and upon them will come the blessing of God.
verses.26: Our lips speak out what is hidden in our hearts.
verses.27: Now, let it be done outside your work area. And now, let it be built in the field for you.
verses.28: Do not be a witness against them in your mouth, and do not speak evil of them.
verses.29: Do not say that since he did this to me, I will do the same to him. I will treat him just as he treated me.
verses.30: I walked over the field of a blind man, and over the land of a man without heart.
verses.31: And behold, all of them rose up. Their faces were covered with dust, and the stone tiles on their bodies were broken apart.
verses.32: And I will hold my heart in my hands. I have seen that they have taken it away from me.
verses.33: A little sleep, a little rest, and a little time to relax our hands.
verses.34: And your head and your limbs will move, just like those of a man who is in pain.
